newsitem.title: FRANCE: French godfather shot dead on parking lot.
newsitem.headline: French godfather shot dead on parking lot.

text.p: One of the last surviving godfathers of the Marseille underworld, cradle of the French drug connection, was shot dead with his companion in a parking lot on Wednesday, police said.
They said a couple shot Jean Toci, 64 and his companion, Berthe Cremieux, from a passing car outside a supermarket at Istres, near Marseille.
Toci had escaped an assassination attempt seven years ago while in jail. He was shot at from outside the prison and suffered only slight wounds from flying glass.

Toci had served sentences for forgery, criminal conspiracy, drug-trafficking, extortion and breaking gambling laws. His last conviction, four years ago, was for running an illegal network of gambling machines.
